description: CaaS Standard Algorithm Catalog - Merged from category files

hybrid-x25519-mlkem768-concat.description: Hybrid KEM: X25519 (128-bit classical) + ML-KEM-768 (Level 3 PQ), concatenation combiner.

hybrid-x448-mlkem1024-concat.description: Hybrid KEM: X448 (224-bit classical) + ML-KEM-1024 (Level 5 PQ), concatenation combiner.

hybrid-ecdsa-p256-mldsa65-concat.description: Hybrid signature: ECDSA P-256 (128-bit) + ML-DSA-65 (Level 3), concatenation combiner.

hybrid-ed25519-mldsa65-concat.description: Hybrid signature: Ed25519 (128-bit) + ML-DSA-65 (Level 3), concatenation combiner.

hybrid-rsa3072-mldsa65-concat.description: Hybrid signature: RSA-3072 (128-bit) + ML-DSA-65 (Level 3), concatenation combiner.

hkdf-sha256.description: HKDF using SHA-256, 32-byte (256-bit) output. Recommended for key expansion.

hkdf-sha384.description: HKDF using SHA-384, 48-byte (384-bit) output. Higher security level.

hkdf-sha512.description: HKDF using SHA-512, 64-byte (512-bit) output. Maximum security level.

pbkdf2-sha256-600000-32.description: PBKDF2 using SHA-256, 600,000 iterations, 32-byte output. OWASP 2023 recommended.

pbkdf2-sha512-210000-64.description: PBKDF2 using SHA-512, 210,000 iterations, 64-byte output. OWASP 2023 recommended.

argon2id-65536-3-4.description: Argon2id with 64 MiB memory, 3 iterations, 4 parallelism. OWASP recommended.

argon2i-65536-4-4.description: Argon2i (side-channel resistant) with 64 MiB memory, 4 iterations, 4 parallelism.

ml-kem-768.description: Module-Lattice KEM, NIST Level 3 (192-bit). FIPS 203. Recommended.

ml-kem-1024.description: Module-Lattice KEM, NIST Level 5 (256-bit). FIPS 203. Highest security.

x25519.description: Curve25519 ECDH key agreement. Fast, constant-time. RFC 7748. Curve approved in NIST SP 800-186; the key-agreement scheme itself is not yet FIPS-approved (pending SP 800-56A incorporation).

x448.description: Curve448 ECDH key agreement. Higher security than X25519. RFC 7748. Curve approved in NIST SP 800-186; the key-agreement scheme itself is not yet FIPS-approved (pending SP 800-56A incorporation).

aes-128-kw.description: AES Key Wrap with 128-bit KEK. RFC 3394, NIST approved.

aes-192-kw.description: AES Key Wrap with 192-bit KEK. RFC 3394, NIST approved.

aes-256-kw.description: AES Key Wrap with 256-bit KEK. RFC 3394, NIST approved. Recommended.

aes-128-kwp.description: AES Key Wrap with Padding, 128-bit KEK. RFC 5649, supports arbitrary data.

aes-192-kwp.description: AES Key Wrap with Padding, 192-bit KEK. RFC 5649, supports arbitrary data.

aes-256-kwp.description: AES Key Wrap with Padding, 256-bit KEK. RFC 5649, supports arbitrary data. Recommended.

hmac-sha256-256.description: HMAC using SHA-256, 256-bit output. Most widely used.

hmac-sha512-512.description: HMAC using SHA-512, 512-bit output. Maximum security.

kmac128-256.description: KECCAK MAC with 128-bit security, 256-bit output. Based on SHA-3.

kmac256-512.description: KECCAK MAC with 256-bit security, 512-bit output. Based on SHA-3.

ml-dsa-44.description: Module-Lattice Digital Signature, NIST Level 2 (128-bit). FIPS 204. Supports optional context string.

ml-dsa-65.description: Module-Lattice Digital Signature, NIST Level 3 (192-bit). FIPS 204. Recommended. Supports optional context string.

ml-dsa-87.description: Module-Lattice Digital Signature, NIST Level 5 (256-bit). FIPS 204. Highest security. Supports optional context string.

slh-dsa-sha2-128s.description: Stateless Hash-based DSA, SHA2, 128-bit security, small signatures. FIPS 205. Supports optional context string.

slh-dsa-sha2-128f.description: Stateless Hash-based DSA, SHA2, 128-bit security, fast signing. FIPS 205. Supports optional context string.

slh-dsa-shake-256s.description: Stateless Hash-based DSA, SHAKE, 256-bit security, small signatures. FIPS 205. Supports optional context string.

hash-ml-dsa-44.description: HashML-DSA-44 (FIPS 204): ML-DSA-44 over a caller-provided digest. Use with DigestSign API. Supports optional context string. OID omitted: NIST Hash* OIDs are digest-specific.

hash-ml-dsa-65.description: HashML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204): ML-DSA-65 over a caller-provided digest. Recommended PQC prehashed signature. Supports optional context string. OID omitted: NIST Hash* OIDs are digest-specific.

hash-ml-dsa-87.description: HashML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204): ML-DSA-87 over a caller-provided digest. Highest security. Supports optional context string. OID omitted: NIST Hash* OIDs are digest-specific.

hash-slh-dsa-sha2-128s.description: HashSLH-DSA-SHA2-128s (FIPS 205): SLH-DSA over a caller-provided digest. Small signatures. Supports optional context string. OID omitted: NIST Hash* OIDs are digest-specific.

hash-slh-dsa-sha2-128f.description: HashSLH-DSA-SHA2-128f (FIPS 205): SLH-DSA over a caller-provided digest. Fast signing. Supports optional context string. OID omitted: NIST Hash* OIDs are digest-specific.

hash-slh-dsa-shake-256s.description: HashSLH-DSA-SHAKE-256s (FIPS 205): SLH-DSA over a caller-provided digest. Highest security. Supports optional context string. OID omitted: NIST Hash* OIDs are digest-specific.

ecdsa-p256-sha256-der.description: ECDSA using NIST P-256 curve with SHA-256, DER-encoded signatures. NIST approved.

ecdsa-p384-sha384-der.description: ECDSA using NIST P-384 curve with SHA-384, DER-encoded signatures. NIST approved.

ecdsa-p521-sha512-der.description: ECDSA using NIST P-521 curve with SHA-512, DER-encoded signatures. NIST approved.

ecdsa-secp256k1-sha256-der.description: ECDSA using secp256k1 curve with SHA-256. Used in Bitcoin/Ethereum.

ed25519.description: Edwards-curve DSA using Curve25519, pure variant. High performance, deterministic.

ed25519ph.description: Ed25519 prehashed variant. Allows signing large messages with external hashing. No distinct OID: RFC 8410 removed the draft ph OIDs.

ed25519ctx.description: Ed25519 with context variant. Allows domain separation via context string. No distinct OID assigned by RFC 8410.

ed448.description: Edwards-curve DSA using Curve448, pure variant. Higher security than Ed25519. Supports optional context string.

rsa-pss-sha256-mgf1-32-2048.description: RSA-PSS with 2048-bit key, SHA-256, 32-byte salt. NIST approved.

rsa-pss-sha256-mgf1-32-3072.description: RSA-PSS with 3072-bit key, SHA-256, 32-byte salt. Recommended minimum for long-term.

rsa-pss-sha384-mgf1-48-4096.description: RSA-PSS with 4096-bit key, SHA-384, 48-byte salt. High security.

rsa-pkcs1v15-sha256-2048.description: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 with 2048-bit key, SHA-256. Legacy, prefer RSA-PSS.

ecdsa-p256-prehashed-der.description: ECDSA P-256 for pre-computed digests. Caller provides digest, service signs directly. Use with DigestSign API.

ecdsa-p384-prehashed-der.description: ECDSA P-384 for pre-computed digests. Caller provides digest, service signs directly. Use with DigestSign API.

ecdsa-p521-prehashed-der.description: ECDSA P-521 for pre-computed digests. Caller provides digest, service signs directly. Use with DigestSign API.

ecdsa-secp256k1-prehashed-der.description: ECDSA secp256k1 for pre-computed digests. Used in Bitcoin/Ethereum with external hashing.

rsa-pss-2048-prehashed.description: RSA-PSS 2048-bit for pre-computed digests. Caller provides digest and declares hash algorithm.

rsa-pss-3072-prehashed.description: RSA-PSS 3072-bit for pre-computed digests. Caller provides digest and declares hash algorithm.

rsa-pss-4096-prehashed.description: RSA-PSS 4096-bit for pre-computed digests. High security for external hashing workflows. 152-bit strength per SP 800-56B Appendix D estimate.

rsa-pkcs1v15-2048-prehashed.description: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 2048-bit for pre-computed digests. Legacy, prefer RSA-PSS-prehashed.

aes-128-gcm-128-96.description: AES with 128-bit key in Galois/Counter Mode, 96-bit IV, 128-bit tag. NIST approved.

aes-192-gcm-128-96.description: AES with 192-bit key in Galois/Counter Mode, 96-bit IV, 128-bit tag. NIST approved.

aes-256-gcm-128-96.description: AES with 256-bit key in Galois/Counter Mode, 96-bit IV, 128-bit tag. NIST approved, recommended.

aes-128-cbc-pkcs7-128.description: AES with 128-bit key in CBC mode, 128-bit IV, PKCS7 padding. Legacy, prefer AEAD.

aes-192-cbc-pkcs7-128.description: AES with 192-bit key in CBC mode, 128-bit IV, PKCS7 padding. Legacy, prefer AEAD.

aes-256-cbc-pkcs7-128.description: AES with 256-bit key in CBC mode, 128-bit IV, PKCS7 padding. Legacy, prefer AEAD.

aes-128-ctr.description: AES with 128-bit key in Counter mode, 96-bit nonce, 32-bit counter. Stream cipher mode.

aes-192-ctr.description: AES with 192-bit key in Counter mode, 96-bit nonce, 32-bit counter. Stream cipher mode.

aes-256-ctr.description: AES with 256-bit key in Counter mode, 96-bit nonce, 32-bit counter. Stream cipher mode.

chacha20-poly1305.description: ChaCha20 (256-bit key) with Poly1305 MAC, 96-bit nonce, 128-bit tag. RFC 8439.

xchacha20-poly1305.description: XChaCha20 (256-bit key) with Poly1305 MAC, 192-bit nonce, 128-bit tag. Extended nonce variant. Not standardized: defined only by an expired IETF draft.
